node.statement: Bijectivity and constant choice. At level one the exact source corner decomposition, the direct sum of the four assumed bijective corner maps, and the target addition isomorphism factor gamma as three linear bijections. Thus gamma is bijective, its matrix maps are precisely its amplifications, and choosing universal a_merge and C_merge to dominate the block, homomorphism, norm, and admissibility constants yields an extended C_merge(rho+epsilon)-isomorphism.
